name: Big Bad Voodoo's Spirit of Bwonsamdi carries the field and cannot be attacked (#7788)
contract: Big Bad Voodoo 802719 summons Spirit of Bwonsamdi 310659. The original CoA creature row for 310659 lists the field 802718 among its own spells, and 802718 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_OWNER with radius index 18 (15 yd) and TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, so the spirit carries the field and its owner is affected only while within 15 yd of it.

AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion.cpp rewrote 802718 into a plain ally-target aura and the summon AI cast it on the player, which put the field and its immunity bubble on the Witch Doctor instead of on the spirit.

The spirit therefore has to hold 802718 itself: its aura visual is Bwonsamdi's bubble, while the Witch Doctor still receives the field's immunity and -50% damage and healing while inside the 15 yd area.
The summoned spirit appears as the translucent bwonsamdispirit display (142802), dances, and cannot be selected or attacked.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Let the spirit apply its field
The summoned spirit carries the field, so its bubble is on Bwonsamdi
The spirit uses the translucent Bwonsamdi spirit display
A hostile unit cannot attack the spirit
The Witch Doctor still receives the field from the spirit
The field still reduces the Witch Doctor's damage dealt by 50%
The field still reduces the Witch Doctor's healing done by 50%
Let the spirit tick at least twice
The spirit keeps the field while it lives
The field stays on the Witch Doctor while he is inside the bubble
The hostile unit still cannot attack the spirit after a tick
